title: Ask to be shown the way
summary: Let nearness be felt as held care before the room turns cold. Keep this close: Hold onto this: longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.
takeaway: Receive the nearness already holding you.
lifeApplication: At the next quiet ache, place a hand on the chest and name the companionship being offered before the mind says alone.

source.shortMeaning: Grace leads longing toward the Beloved through saintly company.
source.lifeApplication: When loneliness tightens, move toward the company that can point you home.
